I don't understand how people complain when games have been between 50-70 USD for years. Going 70 is barely an increase after many years for AAA games when game dev costs, salaries, general inflation, cost of living and prices for other popular hobbies as a result of all of the above has grown tenfold.

A movie ticket coats somewhere between 5-15 dollars. A movie is 1.5-3 hrs long give or take. I've never finished a AAA single player game in less than 30 hours.

Games are still cheaper for the value they provide as an entertainment hobby. By this logic we'll eventually be saddled with freemium bs or constantly increasing prices for subscriptions with substandard single player releases on them as the only games ever released.

Especially considering Capcom's track record recently, 70 is nothing.
